tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background of the console and the site. A cool panel grey, never pure white.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: tables, cards, dialogs, the site's product panels.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed surfaces: table header row, code and log blocks, the unlit part of a meter.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and unlit lamps. 3:1 on ground and panel in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on ground, panel and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, column headers; on ground, panel and sunken (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: THE AGENT COLOUR. Fill only: a lit lamp, the agent's half of the mark, agent lanes in diagrams. Never text; always paired with a lamp-ink edge or a label.

tokens.name: lamp-ink
tokens.usage: Agent colour as text and as the edge of a lit lamp, on ground, panel and lamp-soft.

tokens.name: lamp-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind lamp-ink text: medium severity, the build phase of a work card.

tokens.name: on-lamp
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a lamp fill. Dark in both themes.

tokens.name: gate
tokens.usage: THE HUMAN COLOUR. Primary buttons, approvals, merge, the review phase, links, focus ring, the sandbox half of the mark. As text on ground, panel and gate-soft.

tokens.name: gate-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind gate text: 'waiting for you' states, selected rows.

tokens.name: on-gate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gate fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, merged, healthy. Text on panel and ok-soft; always with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Blocked, invalid, high severity, destructive buttons. Text on panel and danger-soft; always with a word or glyph.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (the Delete button).

tokens.name: paused
tokens.usage: Paused by a person or by a usage limit. Text on panel and paused-soft.

tokens.name: paused-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind paused text.

tokens.name: lane-1
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 1 (ochre). Agent tags and lanes; picked by a hash of the agent name. Text on panel and ground.

tokens.name: lane-2
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 2 (blue).

tokens.name: lane-3
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 3 (plum).

tokens.name: lane-4
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 4 (brick). Always with the name, so it is not read as danger.

tokens.name: lane-5
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 5 (olive).

tokens.name: lane-6
tokens.usage: Agent identity hue 6 (slate).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links: an alias of gate.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset in the ground colour. 3:1+ on every surface.

styles.name: display-1
styles.usage: Site hero only, one per page, lowercase.

styles.name: display-2
styles.usage: Site section heads and product names on the showcase.

styles.name: display-3
styles.usage: Console page titles (Agents, Security, Approvals, Usage).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section heads inside a page, dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: An agent with no work for 15 minutes stops.
styles.usage: All running text and table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Engraved panel labels: lamp states, column heads, eyebrows. Always uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Branch names, commands, log lines, guardrail actions.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and meters; tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Lamp to label, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and chips; gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding (vertical 8, horizontal 12).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, form field gap, minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; card padding on the site.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections in the console.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Site section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Site section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, meter bars, inputs. The system is square-cornered: equipment, not bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, cards, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-lamp
tokens.usage: Lamps and person markers only. Nothing else is round.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Under a panel: a machined edge, not a float.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only.
